package.name: unitree_isaac_policy
package.description: Runs an Isaac Lab-trained policy in ROS 2 by reusing unitree_rl_lab's deploy runtime (ManagerBasedRLEnv / ObservationManager / ActionManager / OrtRunner) rather than re-implementing it: policy_node substitutes ROS topics for DDS LowState and /cmd_vel for the handheld joystick, and pd_node converts the resulting joint position targets to torques - the one step no other deploy target needs, since firmware or the simulator's own actuator model provides it there.
